newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - ECE started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ECE started as buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Accival initiated Mexican restaurateur ECE with a buy recommendation, the brokerage said on Monday.

"The company continues with a growth strategy to widen and diversify its geographic coverage, and in 1997 and 1998 will open one and four units, respectively," analysts Vidal Lavin and Raul Sousa wrote in a report.
The analysts estimated earnings per share of 18.59 pesos for 1997 and 12.32 pesos for 1998.
They hailed the company's recent winning bid for Mexico City's racetrack as a way to diversify its operations.
ECE's shares in Mexico stood at 10.40 pesos in afternoon trading, unchanged from Friday's close.
